title: Oregon Coast Scenic Railroad

services.name: Ticket Agent Position
services.desc: Location: Garibaldi, OR Salary: $15.60/hr + Tips Part-time/Full-time Seasonal Non-exempt Position reports to: Operations Supervisor Position Purpose: In keeping with the mission of Oregon Coast Scenic Railroad, which is to educate about, preserve, and restore the history of logging railroading in the Pacific Northwest, the ticket agent is responsible for the sale of tickets and merchandise to the general public in a kind and respectful manner. Essential Duties: The ticket agent is required to: 1. Prepare cash drawer and on board Point-of-Sale system for the day. 2. Assist the conductor and car host in preparations for the day’s passengers. 3. Monitor inventory stock and restock if needed.

services.name: Groups & Charters
services.desc: From groups of 20 to 200 and more, OCSR can accommodate groups of all sizes with a variety of rail journey options! Travel the scenic Oregon coastline like the railroaders of the past by renting our caboose! This Bay Window caboose, once used on freight trains, is now an ideal car for a small group to enjoy a private train car all to themselves! Perfect for small birthday parties, honeymooners or just people wanting to relive the romance of days gone by where cabooses ruled the rails! Truly a unique way to enjoy a private railroad car at an affordable price. Do you have a big group that you want to take on one of our scheduled excursion trains? Chartering a whole car likely is the best
